program_hint: Regents' Grants (Technology and Research Initiative Fund)
why: Funds multi-university Arizona research on state problems with state agencies as partners (over $36 million to 23 projects, including a $3 million Arizona agriculture and water hub approved in December 2025), so SALSAV should ask how to join or pitch the next call.

org: New York State Energy Research and Development Authority (NYSERDA)
program_hint: Sun and Soil Program (agrivoltaics projects and applied research, first round proposals due 2026-12-10)
why: A new USD 10 million multi-year state program that explicitly funds agrivoltaics demonstrations, applied research, training and market solutions; projects must be in New York, so SALSAV would need a New York partner.

program_hint: Agrivoltaics Research and Demonstration Grant (FY2026-27 window closed 2026-06-15; reported as the final round)
why: The only state grant that names agrivoltaics research, demonstration and outreach and lists universities as eligible, though awards look small and Colorado-sited, so vet whether another round exists and what the largest award is.
